<thought>Retrieve polymorph data for a set of nitride compositions (up to 20) using the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool with the specified energy and count limits, storing the results in a subdirectory within the workdir.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "Li3N",
        "AlN",
        "Si3N4",
        "GaN",
        "InN",
        "BN",
        "TiN",
        "ZrN",
        "HfN",
        "VN",
        "NbN",
        "TaN",
        "CrN",
        "MoN",
        "WN",
        "FeN",
        "CoN",
        "NiN",
        "CuN",
        "AgN"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_nitrides_trial_7/polymorph_data"
}</action_input>
